item.title: ‘All that a footballer wants to do is play football’: Sandesh Jhingan
item.description: India captain Sandesh Jhingan speaks on the ISL, Asian Cup exit, and the growing crisis in Indian football.

item.title: 20 entries, 0 semi-finalist: India Open indicates hosts will play catch-up come World C'ships in Delhi
item.description: India has no representation in the semi-final of the India Open Super 750 for the first time since 2023.

item.title: Olympian Vijender Singh appointed to Asian Boxing Council
item.description: In addition to his Olympic bronze, he has claimed medals at the Commonwealth Games and Asian Games.

item.title: Start of Tata Steel Masters 2026 with Gukesh, Pragg, Arjun in action delayed as protestors dump coal at venue
item.description: "The start of Round 1 has been delayed due to demonstrations near the playing venue," the organisers said in a statement.

item.title: WTT Star Contender Doha: Indian campaign ends as Manika Batra exits in R16
item.description: Manika lost to World No.5 Zhu Yuling of Macao in a straight-game affair.

item.title: WPL 2026: Litchfield, Lanning lead UP Warriorz to second win over Mumbai Indians
item.description: Reigning champions Mumbai Indians fall to second loss in three days against UP Warriorz.

item.title: Men's HIL: Hyderabad Toofans decimate Bengal Tigers
item.description: In the day’s other fixture, table-toppers Vedanta Kalinga Lancers maintained their perfect run with a 6-1 victory over SG Pipers, extending their winning streak to five matches.

item.title: WPL 2026: Smriti Mandhana, Lauren Bell power RCB to fourth straight win
item.description: Smriti Mandhana fell four short of what would have been the first century in WPL history.

item.title: PWL 2026: UP Dominators and Haryana Thunders register dominating wins
item.description: UP outclasses the Tiigers of Mumbai Capitals; meanwhile, Haryana claimed its second win against Delhi Dangal Warriors.

item.title: Bharti Fulmali, Shreyanka Patil return as BCCI announces squad for India tour to Australia
item.description: India will travel to Australia for a multi-format series in February-March, having 3 T20Is, 3ODIs and one test match.
